Wheat is a field crop unlocked at experience level 1.

It is the very first crop unlocked in the game and, by far, the one which is used to make the most different products.

Due to its short production time, wheat is often used to farm experience points or get supplies.

Like all crops, wheat is stored in the silo.

If you have none in your silo, you can buy 10 for 60 coin.

Growing wheat

Wheat is grown in fields by planting another wheat plant (either previously harvested or purchased). Each plot yields 2 plants (net gain of 1 plant) and 1 xp point, and takes 2 minutes to mature.

Selling wheat

  • Wheat can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 36 coin for 10 units.

Boat orders

  • Boat orders ask for:
    • 19 to 29 wheat per crate, up to a total of 58 per boat (for two crates).
    • 14 to 106 wheat per crate, up to a total of 318 per boat (for three crates).
    • 13 to 79 wheat per crate, up to a total of 316 per boat (for four crates).
  • Each unit of wheat gives players 2 coins and 1 experience point in boat orders.

Strategy tips

  • Wheat can be sold to visitors at 28 coins for each 10 units.
  • Harvesting wheat gains you the most xp points and supplies per minute. Continuously harvesting wheat is often called "wheating".
    • However, don't go all out on wheat as you will not be able to continue. Have a wide variety of plants growing at the same time.
    • If you have the sanctuary unlocked, wheating can be a very effective way to produce enough wheat for wheat bundles, although you will want to make sure you have the space beforehand.
  • Wheat sells quickly in the roadside shop, even at the max price of 36, since it is one of the most commonly used crops. However, when wheating, the silo must be emptied rapidly, so the usual selling speed may be too slow.
    • Many players increase selling speed when wheating by pricing their wheat stacks as low as possible: 1 coin.
    • At a price that low, however, the 5-minute cooldown for a free advertisement in the Daily Dirt will quickly outpace the 2-minute harvest time. It is better to advertise wheat for 35 coins and to stock the rest of your shop with wheat priced for 10-34 coins. The advertised wheat will be the last to go, so you can keep re-stocking your shop with cheaper alternatives, maximizing the run-time of the ad and drawing the most possible people to your shop.
  • Wheat is the basic crop, used in making the most amount of products, mainly in the Bakery, Pie Oven, and Cake Oven. It is recommended to always have a good amount in your silo. However, wheat can be found in the Daily Dirt without too much effort.
  • As Wheat is used to make a lot of basic products, such as Chicken Feed, or Bread, it's required to make about 90 products, but both Soybean, and Corn are used for more.
  • The total production time of a max-size wheat crate is 3 hours and 22 minutes, around 17% of a boat's stay time. Therefore it should have low priority in boat management, usually being handled in the background while other production are in progress.
